sources.role: PCem configuration, machine ROM tables, input and NVR/state implementation

paths.path: ~/.pcem/ (or a .pcem directory beside the binary for portable mode); configuration files are per-machine
paths.naming: PCem text configuration files contain machine/video/input settings; joystick mapping is configured through the GUI and no stable public key grammar is guaranteed
GUI joystick configuration stores host device/button/axis assignments; exact serialized fields are release/UI dependent

paths.path: Attached virtual hard/floppy media files and machine NVRAM under the PCem data/config tree
paths.naming: Guest saves are files inside disk images; machine NVRAM uses a per-configuration .nvr file

paths.path: PCem save-state file selected by the UI
paths.naming: Machine state is serialized to a user-selected file; no stable extension/name is specified in the public README
Machine-specific BIOS files use the exact subdirectory/name table in docs/roms.txt, e.g. ibmpcjr/bios.rom and genxt/pcxt.rom; no canonical checksum list is published by PCem

paths.path: PCem data directory under the Windows user profile (or portable .pcem beside the executable)
paths.naming: Per-machine text configuration; joystick mappings configured through UI

paths.path: Per-machine config and joystick configuration dialog
paths.naming: Host joystick device/button/axis assignments; no stable public serialized grammar

paths.path: Attached disk images plus per-machine NVRAM
paths.naming: Guest save files live inside disk images; NVRAM is configuration-associated .nvr data
User-selected serialized machine state; no fixed public extension
Machine-specific names from docs/roms.txt (including ibmpcjr/bios.rom, genxt/pcxt.rom and video-card BIOS names); no canonical checksums

linux-flatpak.reason: The upstream PCem project documents native Linux and Windows builds but no first-party Flatpak package.

macos.reason: The upstream PCem README build instructions cover Linux/BSD and Windows; macOS ports are separate projects and no canonical upstream macOS build is documented.
